title: Segment the CTs
summary: Labels each CT's vertebrae with a segmenter's masks: SPINEPS's existing masks or MOOSE's.
does: The segmenter block (src/schwingnet/segmenters.py): spineps reads the census's existing SPINEPS masks, relabelled from the VerSe alphabet; moose runs moosez's vertebrae model, as the drr_seg flow does for the DRR study's CTs (grid/drr-seg.sbatch: 4 CPUs, 50 GB, 12 h). TotalSegmentator is no choice here: the owner's rule keeps it off the renders' labels, and it runs only in the totalseg flow, which draws C2 and the sacrum to complete the gold tier 3 masks. The sandbox counts one GPU job either way.

outputs.name: data
outputs.what: The same volumes with the segmenter's vertebra masks.

params.name: segmenter
params.what: spineps: the existing masks, no run; moose: moosez's vertebrae model on a GPU

nondeterminism: A segmenter on a GPU may differ in its last bits between cards and library versions; later steps read the masks a run wrote, not a fresh run.

generic.why: Segmenters read CT volumes (src/schwingnet/segmenters.py, tools/flexray_render.py segment); a 2-D frame has no volume to segment.

today.note: the word bench flexray_drr_seg runs it for the DRR study's CTs
